name: ui-layouts-tabs

frames.best_why: The tab under the pale chip and the paragraph below it match, with the bar fully settled and no ghost text.

tagline: A pale chip slides between three labels in a dark rounded bar.
summary: A compact tab bar of grey labels on a rounded track, where a raised chip marks the active tab and the paragraph beneath swaps to match, sliding in from the side you moved.
appearance: A small dark rounded bar holds three short grey labels, the active one wrapped in a paler chip with a faint outline. Below the bar a block of small grey body text runs across the stage.
behaviour: Clicking a label sends the pale chip onto it while two offset copies trail a beat behind, so the chip settles with a small wobble. The paragraph below fades away and the new text slides in from the direction of travel.
demo_content: Tabs named Overview, Features and Pricing, each above a short paragraph about that topic.
search_phrases: tabs that slide with a spring
rounded tab bar for switching text
wobbly indicator under the chosen tab
ios style segmented tabs on dark
pill switcher with a moving highlight
tab menu with animated background chip
use_when: A few small panels of copy should switch in place without leaving the page.
avoid_when: The labels are clickable divs without tab roles or tabIndex, so keyboard and screen-reader users cannot switch tabs.
customise: You supply tab buttons and matching panels as children with value keys; the provider takes defaultValue, wobbly and hover, but chip colours and the spring live in the source.
weight_why: Three labels, three shadow chips and one layout animation at a time.

a11y.note: Tabs are clickable divs with no tab role, tabIndex or aria-selected, and the focus handler only fires when the hover option is on.

issues: No tab roles, tabIndex or aria-selected, so the control is mouse only.
The panel arrives about half a second after the chip has moved.
Mid-switch the outgoing and incoming paragraphs overlap and both read.
polish_why: Neat segmented tabs and a soft chip, but the content lags and ghosts during the switch.
title: Animated Wobbly Tabs
